summary:
Project Description

What if designing a space mission became part of a story worth experiencing?

Our project reimagines space exploration as a cinematic, story-driven interactive game that unfolds much like an interactive film. Through illustrated scenes, dialogue, and character interactions, players follow the story of six characters connected by a shared past and an unexpected discovery that brings them together again.

As they embark on a journey beyond Earth, players witness their evolving relationships and the challenges they face. The narrative remains the heart of the experience, with players following the characters rather than controlling a single protagonist.

Throughout the story, interactive missions invite players to step beyond watching and actively participate in the expedition. They engage with real-world space mission design concepts, including spacecraft configuration, scientific instrument selection, resource management, and engineering trade-offs.

Our goal is to make the unfolding story the driving force behind engagement, keeping players intrigued, emotionally invested, and eager to discover what happens next. Each mission becomes a step toward unlocking the next chapter, blending scientific learning with the excitement of a cinematic adventure.

Ultimately, we aim to turn space exploration into an experience where storytelling sparks curiosity and interactive challenges bring the journey to life.
